reason: My architect already does 3D for us and it's built into their fee, so paying $1,500 a home on top is paying twice. Most of my clients come from referrals and already trust me, so I don't need renders to close them.
objection: My architect already does the 3D and it's in their fee. I'd be paying again for something I already get, and I don't want a third party in the middle of my client and my architect.
